# A merge task of a P0 item starts before the queued P3 tasks, even when the P3 tasks are ready and the slots are almost full.
# Two P0 tasks write the same file, so the second conflicts and the swarm files a merge task of priority P0. The P3 tasks (a body that starts with late) hold their slots until a merge call is in calls.log.
# If the merge task waited behind them, they would all hold both slots until the deadline of the fake agent, and it writes the file starved.
isolate
swarmfakes

env BATCH=2
exec obeeswarm item add swarm swarm-1 --title 'The swarm' --body-file backlog.txt
exec obeeswarm run swarm-1 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star

# The merge task ran once, and no P3 task waited for it in vain.
grep -count=1 '^resolve ' calls.log
! exists starved

# Everything landed.
grep -count=6 '^MergePR ' forge/calls.log
exec grep -rhao '6 landed, 0 need a person, 0 not started' state

-- backlog.txt --
P3	three-a	late-a.txt
P3	three-b	late-b.txt
P3	three-c	late-c.txt
P3	three-d	late-d.txt
P0	zero-a	a.txt
P0	zero-b	a.txt
